revision_prompts.cover_generation:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: square cover painting for Rain Book 6, "Reading Flood News".
Input images: Image 1 is the exact painted watercolour style, finish, light, palette, and age reference; Image 2 is the exact identity, hair, outfits, proportions, and Vanilla reference; Image 3 is an additional in-book identity and rainy-room reference only. Create a brand-new composition, not an edit or variation of the sofa scene.
Primary request: In a warm living room on a rainy day, show the exact recurring girl and boy standing side by side near a large rain-streaked window, with comfortable empty space between their bodies so no limb overlaps another figure. The girl holds a large child-friendly weather sheet/newspaper page at chest height. The sheet has one simple blue raindrop graphic and the exact small label "mm" only. The boy stands beside her and points at the sheet with one hand. Vanilla, the exact small chestnut-and-white papillon, sits separately at their feet looking up. A small wooden radio on a shelf and a TV weather map with simple raindrops are visible but clearly secondary. Rain and a green garden are visible outside.
Style/medium: Match Image 1 exactly: calm luminous hand-painted watercolour and gouache children's science storybook on warm cream paper, natural fine brush detail, soft edges, gentle rain-blue, leaf-green and sunny warm interior colours; reassuring and curious, never glossy 3D or photographic.
Composition/framing: Square 1:1. Full-body figures from head through shoes/paws, all comfortably inside the frame with generous floor margin. Girl on the left, boy on the right, Vanilla centred lower between them but not overlapping either child. Keep the three figures as clean separate silhouettes. Radio on a left shelf; TV farther back on the right; window behind but not confusing silhouettes.
Exact character invariants: girl has the same brown bob, cream knitted cardigan, pink floral dress, white socks and pink Mary Jane shoes as Image 2. Boy has the same curly light-brown hair, blue-and-white striped T-shirt, blue shorts, white socks and grey trainers as Image 2. Vanilla has the same white blaze, chestnut ears/patches, white chest and plumed tail as Image 2.
Anatomy constraints: Girl has exactly 2 arms, 2 hands, 2 separate legs and 2 separate fully visible shoes. Boy has exactly 2 arms, 2 hands, 2 separate legs and 2 separate fully visible shoes. Vanilla has exactly 4 distinct visible legs/paws. No limb is hidden behind another person, the dog, furniture, paper, clothing, or the frame. The weather sheet may cover only the girl's torso, never her arms, hands, legs or feet. The pointing arm and hand are fully readable.
Text (verbatim): "mm"
Constraints: Exactly two children and one dog. NO mother, NO adult, NO sofa, NO seated person. The only readable letters anywhere are "mm" on the weather sheet. No book title. No other words, numbers, symbols, labels, captions, logos, signature, or watermark. The radio and TV remain secondary and do not cover any figure.
